post.description: Draft managed-client bearer profile, not OAuth discovery interoperability. Three new read-only tools, legacy MCP2025-11-25/2025-06-18 only. Each HTTP request and tool invocation rechecks current authorization. Native sessions/API/model tokens rejected.

schema.description: Official MCP JSON-RPC transport envelope; exact tool inputs/outputs are mcp-tools.candidate.json

200.description: JSON-RPC result success OR tool execution failure isError:true,or protocol invalid-params error; see exact wire table

400.description: Selected SDK transport malformed JSON/request/method/header rejection,not an owning operation result

401.description: Invalid credential; WWW-Authenticate Bearer invalid_token; no OAuth resource metadata is advertised

NativeSession.name: Authorization
NativeSession.description: Existing native signed user session only; API/beta/restricted MCP tokens refused.

RestrictedBearer.description: Manual managed-client credential; this does not define an OAuth authorization server.
